note: Contract 2.2: jti is random and at least 128 bits. The bytes are fixed so both sides can hard-code them; the Worker must produce exactly this string for exactly these bytes.
algorithm: base64url without padding, applied to 32 bytes from a CSPRNG

insufficient.name: uuid-with-dashes
insufficient.why: 36 characters, but 122 bits behind two fixed nibbles; the dashes carry no entropy

insufficient.name: repeated-character
insufficient.why: 43 characters, one distinct byte: base64url only, entropy nil

insufficient.name: uuid-hex-no-dashes
insufficient.why: 32 characters, but not base64url - it fails the round-trip and carries 122 bits
